subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14-action grouped upgrade be accepted as one reviewed supply-chain change after privileged-workflow validation, or should credentialed and release actions be split for separate approval?
rationale: The patch does not alter repository permissions or secret wiring, but it replaces executable third-party code across multiple privileged workflow boundaries that normal unit CI cannot exhaustively validate.

options.title: Validate and land the group
options.body: Rebase to current main, verify every new SHA against its official release tag, and require relevant exact-head workflow checks before approving the grouped update.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker login/build, Codex-agent, and CodeQL revisions from lower-risk setup and housekeeping actions for narrower supply-chain review.

options.title: Wait for a stable bot head
options.body: Pause until Dependabot repository access is restored and the branch stops force-pushing long enough to obtain durable current-head evidence.

recommendation.title: Validate and land the group
recommendation.body: Rebase to current main, verify every new SHA against its official release tag, and require relevant exact-head workflow checks before approving the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the broadest recent history across action pins, CI structure, release automation, and Codex-agent workflows touched by the grouped update.
